title: Filtered CE pullback construction with concrete resolution abutment
statement: For every scheme $X$ and bounded-below complex $K$ of abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], choose a termwise hypercohomology presentation $D(X,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. For every scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$, bounded-below complex $L$ on $Y$ and chain map $v:f^{-1}K\to L$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], there are spectral-sequence maps $M_{f,v}$ [def-sp-spectral-sequence], with $E_1$ map $H^p(v^q)\circ f^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. There are simultaneously chosen stabilization bounds $R(X,K,q,n)$ and isomorphisms $e_{X,K,q,n,r}:E_r^{q,n-q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q H^n(X,K)$ for $r\geq1,R(X,K,q,n)$. For every map $j:f^{-1}\rho_X(K)\to\rho_Y(L)$ of the resolutions in $D$ whose composite with $f^{-1}\rho_X.map$ is homotopic to $v\circ\rho_Y.map$, for every chain map $w:\Gamma(X,\rho_X)\to\Gamma(Y,\rho_Y)$ whose components are the sectionwise inverse-image unit followed by $\Gamma(j)$, there are maps $t_q$ of the finite image-filtration steps commuting with their inclusions and the map $e_{\rho_X}^{-1}H^n(w)e_{\rho_Y}$ on the abutment [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], where $e_\rho$ is the canonical resolution isomorphism of the presentation. For every proof that $t_q$ commutes with successive step inclusions, the stable-page map under $e$ equals the cokernel map induced by $t_{q+1},t_q$. No equality with the derived adjunction unit--Leray composite is asserted.

proof.text: Take the coherent filtered CE total presentations, page maps, stationary bounds and identifications. For each (f,v), take the map g from inverse image of the source CE total into the chosen target resolution, its global-sections map s, and the finite-diagonal comparison e.

Identify the presentation w_X with e.hom followed by Γ(comparison_X), checking the specified summand equation against w_formula. Every nonnegative resolution index is the image of a natural number, so those equations cover it. Negative resolution-index summands are zero after extension by zero and contribute uniquely. Total-complex extensionality completes the equality.

The source CE augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism by its augmented-row formula. Exact inverse image preserves it. The target resolution is K-injective. For any supplied j over v, map the presentation homotopy aug ≫ comparison ~ ρ.map through inverse image, compose with j, then compose with hj. Both g and inverse image(comparison) followed by j agree over the same augmentation. Injectivity of precomposition in the homotopy category makes them homotopic.

Construct the sectionwise unit as a genuine chain map from its naturality, proved for any abelian Grothendieck coefficient category with small-site sheafification and specialized to abelian groups. Apply Γ to the preceding homotopy, and precompose by e and that unit. The supplied component equations for s and w, naturality of the unit under comparison, and w_X = e ≫ Γ(comparison_X) identify its two endpoints. Homotopic chain maps induce the same cohomology map, so H(e ≫ s) = H(w_X ≫ w).

Use c_X.hom = H(w_X) followed by the source resolution cohomology isomorphism. Cancel that isomorphism to obtain c_X.inv followed by H(w_X) equal to its inverse. Functoriality of homology identifies the conjugate of H(e ≫ s) with the displayed conjugate of H(w). Rewrite the filtration-inclusion equation using this equality, retaining the same t and stable-page equation.
